SELECT s.id, s.spot_name AS name, s.province, s.city, s.address, s.latitude, s.longitude, s.altitude, s.light_pollution_level AS bortleLevel, s.rating, s.rating_count AS ratingCount, s.description, /* fullDescription 复用 description（表里没有单独的 full_description 列） */ s.description AS fullDescription, /* mainImage 从 images 第一张取 */ CASE WHEN s.images IS NULL OR s.images = '[]' OR s.images = '' THEN NULL ELSE JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(s.images, '$[0]')) END AS mainImage, s.create_time AS createTime, /* 当前用户评分 */
(SELECT r.score FROM tb_spot_rating r WHERE r.user_id = #{currentUserId} AND r.spot_id = s.id LIMIT 1)
NULL
AS myScore, /* 今日签到人次（用 checkin_date，表里专门有这个日期字段做每日去重） */ (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_user_checkin c WHERE c.spot_id = s.id AND c.checkin_date = CURDATE()) AS todayCheckinCount, /* 累计签到人次 */ (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM tb_user_checkin c WHERE c.spot_id = s.id) AS totalCheckinCount FROM tb_observation_spot s WHERE s.id = #{spotId} AND s.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
